context: Reproduce the current schema-to-adapter behavior, align choices with the authoritative adapter/CLI contract, add negative and effective-backend tests, and update docs and the option matrix without starting Ray/Dask services.
description: Adversarial review found that the MCP schema accepts engine=\"pandas\", while the Modin adapter and CLI registry support ray or dask. An accepted pandas value can therefore fail late or be interpreted inconsistently. Revalidate the installed Modin/backend contract and make the MCP schema reject unsupported engines or implement a deliberate backend with complete lifecycle and resource semantics; do not silently accept an invalid engine.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not broaden the MCP option to every backend accepted by an installed dependency
anti_patterns.instead: Allow only the reviewed ray/dask set
anti_patterns.why: Backend support also requires resource, lifecycle, and security review

anti_patterns.dont: Do not keep pandas in the allowlist merely because it resembles a valid Modin engine name
anti_patterns.instead: Reject pandas or implement it completely with an explicit backend contract
anti_patterns.why: An accepted but unsupported value fails late and creates an unreliable public contract

anti_patterns.dont: Do not use a mocked forwarded kwargs assertion as proof
anti_patterns.instead: Assert the effective backend selected by the adapter
anti_patterns.why: Forwarding can succeed while the effective backend remains unchanged

preserves.behavior: CLI-supported ray and dask behavior and existing Modin defaults remain compatible.
No arbitrary package, driver, or backend installation control is added to MCP.
Validation tests do not initialize a real Ray or Dask cluster.

prior_art.concept: CLI registry exposes ray and dask choices

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/mcp/test_schemas.py tests/unit/platforms -q
verifications.description: Unsupported pandas is rejected on the unfixed tree regression
verifications.expected: exits 1 on the unfixed tree when pandas is asserted invalid; exits 0 after supported-engine validation is enforced

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/mcp tests/integration/mcp -q
verifications.description: Durable and tool paths preserve effective engine selection
verifications.expected: exits 1 on the unfixed tree if replay loses or changes the backend; exits 0 after focused coverage passes

verifications.command: uv run -- ruff check benchbox/mcp benchbox/platforms/dataframe/modin_df.py tests/unit/mcp tests/unit/platforms tests/integration/mcp
verifications.description: Scoped Modin and MCP checks are clean
verifications.expected: exits 1 on the unfixed tree if the patch has lint defects; exits 0 after scoped checks pass

work_units.evidence: Schema half already closed by PR #1486, which narrowed modin engine choices from ('pandas','ray','dask') to ('ray','dask'); validate_platform_options('modin',{'engine':'pandas'}) already raises. NOT re-implemented. Remaining defect: ModinDataFrameAdapter.__init__ (modin_df.py:155-201) accepts any engine string with no validation -- self.engine = engine, then _configure_engine() does os.environ.setdefault('MODIN_ENGINE', self.engine), so 'pandas' or any typo is written straight into Modin's environment and fails late or silently mis-executes. Authoritative supported set confirmed as ray/dask from three independent sources: the MCP allowlist choices, _apply_tuning's engine_affinity filter (modin_df.py:214 accepts only ('ray','dask')), and the ImportError install hint naming modin[ray]/modin[dask].
work_units.summary: Reproduce invalid pandas behavior and confirm the authoritative supported backend set.

work_units.evidence: w1: SUPPORTED_MODIN_ENGINES=frozenset({'ray','dask'}) + ModinDataFrameAdapter._validate_engine() called from __init__ BEFORE _configure_engine writes MODIN_ENGINE; _apply_tuning's engine_affinity filter now reads the same constant so the two allow-lists cannot drift. w2: tests/unit/platforms/dataframe/test_modin_df_coverage.py TestSupportedEngineIsFailClosed (pandas rejected by name, 5 unreviewed backends rejected, 4 accepted/normalized cases, adapter-vs-MCP-allowlist parity, constructor rejects before MODIN_ENGINE is set, engine_affinity shares the constant) plus tests/unit/mcp/test_benchmark_tools.py effective-backend test (adapter.engine=='dask', not a forwarded-kwargs assertion) and run-surface fail-closed test. Negative control: reverting only modin_df.py fails 13. w3: docs/reference/mcp.md records the reviewed ray/dask set and why pandas is rejected. Ladder rung1 8219 passed, rung2 684 passed, rung3 ruff clean. No Ray or Dask cluster is initialized by any test (_configure_engine patched).
